# Mozamandu (Moja Mandu / मोझामान्डु)

> Mozamandu is Nepal's premier online store specializing in high-quality, comfortable, and stylish socks (moja / मोजा), boxers, undergarments, and daily essential wear. We offer fast home delivery across Kathmandu Valley and nationwide delivery all over Nepal.

## Key Brand Information
- **Official Name**: Mozamandu (also known as Mojamandu, Moja Mandu, Mozamandu Nepal)
- **Website**: https://mozamandu.com
- **Core Category**: Socks (Moja / मोजा), Boxers, Undergarments & Essentials in Nepal
- **Location & HQ**: Kathmandu, Bagmati, Nepal
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +977-9761691727
- **Customer Email**: info@mozamandu.com
- **Delivery Coverage**: Inside Kathmandu Valley (1-2 days delivery), All 77 Districts of Nepal (2-4 days)
- **Payment Options**: Cash on Delivery (COD), eSewa, Khalti, Bank Transfer (ConnectIPS)

## Main Product Offerings
- **Combed Cotton Ankle Socks**: High-density combed cotton ankle socks engineered for daily comfort and durability.
- **Boxers & Multipacks**: Premium 100% cotton boxers, 4-piece multipacks, sporty stretch boxers.
- **Athletic & Sports Socks**: Cushion-padded sports socks for running, gym, and activewear in Nepal.
